questions.q: Two trains, 220m and 260m long, run on parallel tracks in opposite directions. Their speeds are in the ratio 5:7. If they cross each other in 16 seconds, find the speed of the faster train.
questions.solution: The trains jointly cover 220+260=480 m in 16 seconds, so combined speed is 30 m/s. Faster share is 7/12, giving 17.5 m/s=63 km/h.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and then allows two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. Find his overall profit percentage.
questions.solution: Use cost 100. Selling price = 140×0.90×0.95=119.7. Profit is 19.7%.

questions.q: A vessel contains a mixture of milk and water in the ratio 7:3. Another vessel contains a mixture of milk and water in the ratio 4:5. In what ratio should the two mixtures be combined so that the resulting mixture has milk and water in the ratio 3:2?
questions.solution: Milk fractions are 7/10 and 4/9, with target 3/5. Alligation gives first:second = (3/5−4/9):(7/10−3/5)=14:9.

questions.q: The present ages of A, B and C are in the ratio 3:4:5. Eight years ago, the sum of their ages was 48 years. Find C's present age.
questions.solution: Present total is 48+3×8=72 years. Twelve ratio units equal 72, so one unit is 6. C’s age is 5×6=30.

questions.q: A solid toy is in the form of a cone mounted on a hemisphere of the same radius. The radius of the hemisphere is 7 cm and the height of the cone is 24 cm. Find the total surface area of the toy. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution: Cone slant height = √(7²+24²)=25 cm. Exposed area = πrl+2πr² = (22/7)×7×25+2×(22/7)×49=858 cm².

questions.q: What is Rahul's present age? I. Rahul is 5 years older than Sohan. II. The ratio of Rahul's age to Sohan's age is 4:3.
questions.solution: The difference alone permits many ages; the ratio alone permits many scales. Together, ages 4k and 3k differ by 5, giving Rahul’s age 20.

questions.q: What is the profit percentage earned by a shopkeeper on an article? I. The cost price of the article is Rs 800. II. The selling price of the article is 25% more than the cost price.
questions.solution: Statement II directly says selling price exceeds cost by 25%, which is the profit percentage. A cost figure alone cannot determine profit.

questions.q: What is the area of a triangle? I. The base of the triangle is 10 cm. II. The perimeter of the triangle is 30 cm.
questions.solution: Neither statement fixes height. Even together, base 10 and perimeter 30 permit triangles with different side lengths and areas.

questions.q: Is the positive integer x greater than 15? I. x is a multiple of 8, and x > 10. II. x² > 200.
questions.solution: The smallest multiple of 8 above 10 is 16, so I settles the question. II permits 15, which is not greater than 15, as well as larger integers.

questions.q: Is the number Y divisible by 6? I. Y is divisible by 12. II. Y is divisible by 18.
questions.solution: Every multiple of 12 and every multiple of 18 is divisible by 6. Each statement alone therefore answers yes.

questions.q: What is the total number of employees in Company Q?
questions.solution: Company Q has 270 women, equal to 45% of its employees. Total = 270/0.45=600.

questions.q: The compound interest on a sum of Rs 8,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum, compounded annually, exceeds the simple interest on the same sum for the same time and rate by how much?
questions.solution: For two years, compound interest minus simple interest is P(r/100)². Thus 8000×(0.10)²=₹80.

questions.q: A committee of 5 members is to be formed from 6 men and 4 women. In how many ways can this be done if the committee must include at least 3 women?
questions.solution: Choose 3 women and 2 men, or 4 women and 1 man. Count = C(4,3)C(6,2)+C(4,4)C(6,1)=60+6=66.

questions.q: Pipe A can fill a tank in 10 hours and Pipe B can fill it in 15 hours. Pipe C can empty the full tank in 12 hours. If all three pipes are opened together for 4 hours and then Pipe C is closed, how many more hours will A and B together take to fill the remaining part of the tank?
questions.solution: Combined rate for four hours is 1/10+1/15−1/12=1/12 tank per hour. A third is filled, leaving 2/3. A and B fill 1/6 tank per hour, requiring four more hours.

A boat's speed in still water is 20 km/h. It takes 2 hours more to cover 96 km upstream than to cover the same distance downstream. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution: Let stream speed be s. Then 96/(20−s)−96/(20+s)=2. Simplifying gives s²+96s−400=0; its positive root is 4 km/h.
